svg.title: P0 Concept B — Ámbito finder with a user-initiated locate action (phone 375x812)
svg.desc: Annotated wireframe of proposed Concept B on a 375x812 phone: three states of a bounded ámbito finder sheet, a user-initiated camera move and the way back. Proposed design, not implemented.

Distances shown (51 m, 467 m, 474 m, 781 m) are real nearest-vertex computations from data/planning/madrid_ambitos.geojson to the default Lens A centre.
Phase values and buildability shown in State 3 are layout placeholders, NOT readings from madrid_ambito_state.json.
The <details name> accordion and 44 px targets drawn in the rail belong to P1 and are specified separately.
NOT TESTED: no human user, no real iPhone/iPad hardware, no assistive technology. Proposed design only.
